summary: OpenAI announced commitments to support the U.S. Department of Energy's Genesis Mission, providing funded API and Codex access, specialized bioscience and cyber capabilities, and early model access to national-laboratory and university researchers.

mechanisms.reason: OpenAI is committing funded API and Codex access that expands token usage among thousands of researchers, though the dollar figures are modest relative to industry scale.
mechanisms.quote: Offer participating researchers up to $10 million in API usage for $2.5 million spent, expanding the work Genesis researchers can support.

practices.reason: OpenAI describes lab-internal evaluation work on safe multimodal AI use in laboratory settings, informative but not a transferable instrument.
practices.quote: In bioscience, OpenAI and Los Alamos developed evaluations to study how multimodal AI systems can be used safely by scientists in realistic laboratory environments.
